title: Rules with room for joy
meaning: Common rules help you act together when they leave room for simple delight in what you have done.
text: Working together can be pleasant when you need not establish the foundations of every decision afresh. The Hierophant in the physical position of Manipura suggests drawing on an agreement, a familiar method and respect for experience passed on to you. The Hierophant in energy shows why you choose this approach: you want to preserve values you both share. The Sun in emotions lets you enjoy the result openly and simply. The repeated card distinguishes acting according to a rule from inward loyalty to a principle, while the sunny response brings human warmth to the undertaking.

Suppose you decide to sort shared photographs once a month. Each has a part, the selection method is clear and favourite pictures go into an album. **A good arrangement makes room for living enjoyment.** An amusing photograph appears, and you linger over it. That pause can make the activity valuable, showing why you adopted the rule and what you want to preserve together.

The difficulty starts if a successful arrangement becomes the only correct one. Missing an evening causes more concern than losing time together, while spontaneous laughter seems to disrupt the schedule. Joy must then arrive through the approved procedure and confirm its perfection. Your principles need no such proof. They support shared will better when they remain understandable foundations for action and allow adjustments for the life they serve.
